title: License records for anything not authored here (data/src/licensing_manifest.yaml)
description: Every external source used as a validation anchor or cited fact must appear here. tools/check_provenance.py rejects an artifact whose provenance.upstream has no record, and rejects any record whose license is not in common.schema.json#/$defs/accepted_license.
